text:
The reversible reaction shown takes place in a closed system at constant temperature.
P(g)  +  Q(g)  +  R(g)
S(g)  +  T(g)
When the reaction has reached equilibrium, more T is added.
After the addition of T, which other substances increase in concentration?
A
P, Q, R and S
B
P and Q only
C
P, Q and R only
D
S only
subject: Chemistry
